description: Render one photo's whole frame, after crop and rotation, with its current Develop settings by a temporary export (JPEG quality 80, sRGB, output sharpening off, no catalog add) at the requested long edge, never enlarged; any photo, the one open in Develop included, whose thumbnail the preview tools refuse. Returns photo_id, width, height, bytes, jpeg_quality, left_on_photo and the image, which is Lightroom's JPEG unchanged: a rendition over 3.5 MiB is not re-encoded but answered unknown, so ask for a smaller size. Each call adds one Export history step to the photo and marks it exported (left_on_photo: "one Export history step", "the exported mark"); Develop settings and pixels stay unchanged unless the AI Updates dialog updates the masks (below). For the photo open in Develop, take one look before editing and one after, not one per step: each call leaves one Export history step. Like other writes it first commits a slider change pending in Develop, then renders the saved settings the export reads: a slider still moving or an AI update still pending may be missing. It runs alongside Develop calls. While this plug-in's export_photos, get_photo_detail or another render_photo runs, it is refused, not queued, with nothing written; an export started from Lightroom's own menu does not take that lock, and the lock lapses 300 s after the running export last started a photo, though a still-open export session or dialog can make the next rendition wait or time out. A photo with outdated AI masks opens Lightroom's AI Updates Recommended dialog, which blocks the call until dismissed: Export with "Update affected photos" unchecked renders the existing AI computation; checked, it first updates the AI masks, which can visibly change the photo; Cancel stops before rendering, so no Export step is created, but the call is unknown and names the possible trace; a timeout while the dialog is open is unknown. A call refused before the render (unknown photo, export running) is failed with nothing left; an error once the render started is unknown and names the export and what it leaves on the photo.

photo_ids.description: One photo ID or file path

size.description: Long edge of the rendition: cull is 864, review 1728, the default; numeric 64-2048 means that edge. A photo whose cropped frame is smaller is rendered at its own size. Image tokens grow with pixel area (Claude: about width x height / 750) and repeat each turn in history.

name: render_photo
title: Render photo
